### ST-078

**Mirror and colocated layouts**

*As a **developer**, I want **test paths computed from source paths using mirror or colocated layout**, so that **my test tree stays organised automatically**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 5 | S8 | H01, H02, §13.4 | [ST-037](SRC-source-intelligence.md#st-037), [ST-022](DET-project-detection.md#st-022) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Mirror maps `src/modules/auth/AuthService.ts` → `tests/unit/modules/auth/AuthService.test.ts`
- [x] Colocated maps to `src/modules/auth/AuthService.test.ts`
- [x] The detected existing convention is the default

**Domain and custom layouts with naming tokens**

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Invalid templates fail validation with the offending token

### ST-081

**Unit and integration scaffolding without fake coverage**

*As a **developer**, I want **test skeletons with one explicit TODO per public method**, so that **gaps are visible and never counted as passing tests**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 8 | S8 | H08, H09, §13.8 | [ST-078](GEN-test-architecture-generator.md#st-078), [ST-080](GEN-test-architecture-generator.md#st-080), [ST-082](GEN-test-architecture-generator.md#st-082) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Scaffolds use `it.todo`/`test.todo` (never empty passing tests)
- [x] Generated files compile; unresolved dependencies are reported
- [x] `smarttest generate --class|--module|--type` targets work

### ST-082

**Existing test detection and collision prevention**

*As a **developer**, I want **the generator to recognise existing tests and never overwrite them**, so that **my work is safe**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 5 | S8 | H10, H11, §13.8 | [ST-052](EXE-test-execution.md#st-052), [ST-078](GEN-test-architecture-generator.md#st-078) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] A source file already covered by a test (any location) is not scaffolded again
- [x] Path collisions are reported; nothing is overwritten by default
- [x] `--force` is not offered for files containing non-generated code

### ST-083

**Generator dry-run and atomic writes**

*As a **developer**, I want **to preview generated files and have writes be atomic**, so that **partial generation never corrupts my tree**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 3 | S9 | H12, §13.8 | [ST-081](GEN-test-architecture-generator.md#st-081) |

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Writes are all-or-nothing per run
- [x] Generation is repeatable: second run yields no changes
